node.statement: Lemma 5.5 (Second moment of GPS, general): For psi_sym on Sym^n(C^d), E[sigma_hat_v tensor sigma_hat_v] = ((n-1)/n)(psi_sym)_{1,2} + (1/n)((psi_sym)_1 tensor I + I tensor (psi_sym)_1)SWAP + (1/n^2)SWAP - Lower_{psi}, where Lower in SoS(d). Proof: Apply Proposition 5.1 with k=2 and Lemma 5.3. The X_{n+2}X_{n+1} term gives the marginal and SWAP terms; the (n+1,n+2) transposition gives additional SWAP contribution. Partial traces computed via Proposition 2.4.
